# 11th Annual Josie Music Awards

| previous = 2024
| next = 2026
| main =
}}
The 11th Annual Josie Music Awards  was held on November 2, 2025 at the Grand Ole Opry House honoring independent music artists, songwriters, and industry professionals. Lorrie Morgan was honored with the Lifetime Career Achievement Award and Steve Dorff was honored with the Songwriter Legend Award.
